blocker.description: The minion attempting the block, or that blocked, and its intercept.

card.description: The action card, for a card action.

declined.description: The Methuselahs who declined to block.

source.description: The card in play granting the action (a location's, an equipment's).

Allocated.description: Points allocated to a Methuselah or a card in play.

Allocation.description:
An allocation of points under way, answered whole with
`Command::Allocate`: all `points` given, at most `cap` to a recipient,
at least `min_nonzero` recipients given some.

oneOf.description: No allocation under way.
Not one amount per recipient.
The amounts do not add up to the points.
A recipient over its cap.
Fewer recipients given points than required.

seed.description:
Its sampling seed: replaying uses the recorded options, the seed
re-simulates the bot.

weights.description: The weights' SHA-256, for a network.

oneOf.description: A standing order (`vote_all`) or an allocation answered whole.
A lone pass, the seat's settings hiding the rest.

Card.description:
A physical card: its copy where the viewer may follow it, its KRCG id
where the viewer sees its face. A card in another seat's hand, a
library or a crypt has neither (a card back).

crypt.description: A crypt card (else a library card), hidden or not.

nth.description:
Its label among the copies of the same card from the same deck the
viewer sees (1, 2…: "Embrace #2"): the lowest number no other
visible copy holds, given as it comes into sight. With `id` only.

CardRef.description:
A card an option names: its KRCG id when the viewer may know it, its
copy when it is one physical card (on the table; not a card in hand,
where copies alike are one option).

from.description: Played from cards stored on this card in play, not from the hand.

ChoiceKey.description:
What identifies an option: two options of one decision never share a
key (copies alike in hand are one option). A record keeps each answer
by its key, with the engine's copy numbers: a later engine finds the
same option whatever its index or however it describes it.

ability.description: Which of a card's abilities, when it has several.

actor.description: The minion playing the card, using the ability, taking the action.

amount.description: An amount: blood, pool, votes, X, points.

blood.description: The blood an ability moves onto (+) or off (−) the vampire it is on.

card.description: The card played, used, taken, discarded or named.

minion.description:
The minion the option is about otherwise (blocker, voter, payer,
the vampire an ability is on).

mode.description: The mode a card is played in (`play`).

value.description: A clan, a Discipline, a circle chosen: its snake_case id.

zone.description: Where a card chosen by name comes from (a search).

strike.description:
Its strike once declared (the blocker chooses knowing the acting
minion's), kept shown once resolved until the next pair.

sides.description: Each side, the acting minion's first.

options.description:
The options shown (the seat's settings may hide some: indices keep
the engine's numbering).

prompt.description:
What is chosen, in English ("Camarilla's Iron Fist: choose the
Methuselah who gains 1 pool"), when the seat's settings ask for text.

source.description:
The card (or minion, by its card) whose terms or effect this
decision chooses, when it is one: the options' `effects` say what
each choice gets.

undo.description: `Command::Undo` would take back the seat's previous decision.

Effect.description: One thing an option does, to whom.

copy.description: The minion or card in play it applies to.

role.description: What a chosen minion or Methuselah becomes (`role`).

seat.description: The Methuselah it applies to (a pool, a hand).

oneOf.description:
A card moved to a zone (`to`): a hand, a library, the
uncontrolled region.
The card or minion stays (a cost paid to keep it).
What a chosen minion or Methuselah becomes for the card (`role`).
A value this reader does not know.
One Methuselah left (or none).

The last human seat was ousted: the bots do not play on (victory
points as they stand).
A seat left (`Command::Leave`) or went idle too long.

The engine failed (or ran out of steps); the game is recorded with
the failure.

A decision answered (by a human, a bot, a standing order or a lone
pass).

at.description:
Milliseconds since the start, when the host received the
answer (a human's think time includes the client's pacing).

forced.description: Every option offered was this choice.

shown.description: The options the seat was shown, when its settings hid some.

oneOf.description:
The seat took back its decisions from `to` on: the game continues
from `to`, decision numbers repeat from there, and a reader drops
the decision entries it takes back.
A command refused.
Not the pending decision (answered already, or a stale client).
The pending decision is another seat's, or none is pending.
No option with that index.
Nothing to take back.
No allocation under way, or amounts it does not allow.
No vote to cast that way.
`join` first, with a valid token.
Not valid JSON, or not a command.
Too many commands: slow down.

text.description: The event told in English, when the seat's settings ask for text.

oneOf.description: A decision taken, by any seat, as the recipient may know it.

The seat took back its decisions from `to` on: the client drops
what it showed since (the next view is the table at `to`).

effect.description:
A lasting effect whose card is in the ash heap (a marker on
its minion), not a card of its own: no copy.

minion.description: A minion (a vampire, an ally, a token), not a card on the table.

oneOf.description: A card in play moves to another minion (or off one).

A lasting effect whose card is in the ash heap (a marker on
its minion), not a card of its own: no copy.

oneOf.description:
A minion or a card leaves play: to `to` when it went to a seat's
zone (a burned minion to its ash heap), contested (a vampire set
aside while its Methuselahs contest it).

effect.description:
A lasting effect whose card is in the ash heap (a marker on
its minion), not a card of its own: no copy.

enters.description: Goes to torpor (true) or leaves it.

action.description: The political action it was called by.

hunted.description: A blood hunt's: the diablerist hunted.

oneOf.description:
A combatant's strike declared (the acting minion's first: the
blocker chooses knowing it); `None`: no strike.

A pair of strikes resolved: each side's strike and the damage it
dealt before prevention.

bots.description: Per bot seat, the profile resolved.

spec.description:
The spec as played: the seed always set, human seats' names
replaced by "human".

failure.description: The engine's failure, when it failed: message, location, backtrace.

seed.description:
The deal's seed; the host picks one when absent (and records it).
32 bits: exact as a JSON number in every language.

time_limit.description: In player turns; the engine's default when absent.

In.title: In
In.description:
A command as sent: an optional client id, echoed by an `error` it
causes.

oneOf.description:
Take the seat (the first frame on a connection: the seat's token,
on a server), or take it again after a disconnection: `after` the
last message's `seq` received, the host resends what followed;
otherwise `joined`, then the pending decision if it is the seat's.
Take an option of the pending decision, by its `index`.

Answer an allocation under way whole: one amount per recipient, in
the decision's `allocation.recipients` order.

Cast all the votes the decision's `votes` counts one way; a
standing order for the rest of the polling (each vampire's turn
to cast is answered by it).

Take back the seat's last decision, from the pending `decision`
(whose `undo` says it can: nothing decided since, nothing hidden
revealed). Named so a command sent twice undoes once.

Change some of the seat's settings; the pending decision is sent
again under them.
Leave the game: it ends, recorded as abandoned by the seat.

stored.description: Cards stored on it (face down ones hidden to others), top last.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds without a command before the game ends as abandoned.

Marker.description:
Public state on a minion beyond blood and cards: counters, marks,
effects lasting a while.

seat.description: The Methuselah it belongs to (corruption counters).

text.description: English, when the seat's settings ask for text.

Public state on a minion beyond blood and cards (completed with
the host, A3).

disciplines.description: Empty for a card without Discipline requirement.

The printed line (one line may split into several modes, told

index.description:

minion.description:

mode.description: The mode a card is played in (`play`).

text.description: The option in English, when the seat's settings ask for text.

value.description: A clan, a Discipline, a circle chosen: its snake_case id.

Out.title: Out
Out.description:
A message as sent: numbered per seat from 1, so a client rejoining
`after` the last it received gets the rest.

reply_to.description: The client id of the command it answers (an `error`).

oneOf.description:
What one step of the game did, in order: a decision taken (its
first event: `decided`, `auto_passed` or `undone`) and what
followed until the next decision; or, once, the deal. With the
table after it when the seat's settings ask views on every step.

The seat must decide; sent again on `join` and after a settings
change while pending.
A command refused; the game is unchanged.

vp_halves.description: Per seat, in halves of a victory point.

winner.description:
The game's winner: the most victory points, at least 2 of them,
alone.

oneOf.description: The game is over.

them): a network policy at a temperature, or a scripted style.

calling.description: The calling minion, if any (a blood hunt's has none).

What a chosen minion or Methuselah becomes for the card choosing it

name.description:

limbo.description: Cards the seat is playing, not resolved yet.

Victory points, in halves of a point (a survivor at the time limit
scores 1 half).

Settings.description:
A human seat's preferences (fields left out take their default);
changed during the game by `Command::Settings`.

opportunities.description:
Asked about every opportunity (true), or only in its moment
(false): a wake outside an action that concerns the seat, a block
denial short of the action's stealth, an any-time ability where
nothing else is on offer are passed over; a decision left with a
pass alone passes by itself.

text.description:
English renderings beside the data (`text` on options, events,
markers, strikes; a decision's `prompt`): for a client that does
not compose its own.

views.description:
Table views sent on every step (bots' included: a client
animating each move) or only with the seat's decisions and the
game's end.

SettingsPatch.description: Some settings to change; the others stay.

banished.description: A banished vampire, waiting to be influenced out again.

cards.description: The cards it carries there, out of play until it returns.
